title: 🤖 Microsoft’s CEO Explains the Future of Jobs!
body: 🤖 Microsoft’s CEO Explains the Future of Jobs!
At the DealBook Summit, Satya Nadella explained why he offered a voluntary exit to around 60,000 employees last October.
He said the company is shifting to a model built on AI, where an employee’s role becomes managing AI agents instead of doing the work themselves.
Simply put, the job of the future is not doing the tasks, but directing AI and supervising it — and the voluntary offer was an alternative to mass layoffs.
Do you think managing AI will become an essential skill? And why?
